title: The entry process was...
text: The entry process was confusing. The directions mentioned needing ID, but nobody checked. It wasn't clear if we had actually found the right place to use our "skip the line" tickets. Once inside, everything was spectacular.
author: Terry_O

title: Rough beginning, great ending
text: We only had a couple days in Barcelona, so we took the quick entry ticket.  We had some difficulty finding the right entrance for the ticket we purchased.  The ticket I had wasn’t the right one, and I was in an endless loop trying to log into Viator to get the ticket.  I even called the number on my reservation, and got voice mail, left my number, and NEVER got a call back.  Finally found the correct ticket in my WhatsApp. The one in the email wasn’t correct for entry.  The staff at the gate was wonderful and patient while I was trying to find it.
